name: Aiva
description:
Aiva helps clinicians get things done on Claude for Healthcare!

Give your clinicians real-time voice control over every IT enterprise system in your hospitals including:

- Work orders in ServiceNow: Submit an IT Service Management ticket the moment you see a problem, speeding resolution

- Policies & Procedures in Wolters Kluwer and Elsevier: Look up proprietary and licensed content real-time, improving utilization and outcomes.

- EHRs like Epic and Oracle Cerner: Voice chart across multiple rows and flowsheets in a single command, reducing latency, improving compliance, decreasing incidental overtime and increasing staff and patient satisfaction scores. Lookup vitals, labs and other information from the EHR in real-time.

- Dietary like CBORD and Computrition: Give nurses immediate access to all the dietary order information they need without having to place calls or go hunting for information, improving service while reducing distractions.

- Messaging tools like Vocera, Voalte and TigerConnect: Send messages to colleagues without having to open up different apps, facilitating communication across the hospital

- Smart Patient Rooms built with Siemens, Johnson Controls, Trane, Schneider Electric: Smart devices like lights, blinds, thermostats and TVs, freeing up more time for higher-value direct care.

- Patient experience via GetWell, Sonifi, pCare, Vibe, Aceso: Clinicians can play programming for patients like educational videos and meal information.

Aiva clients have  reported ROI metrics at the AHA, AMIA and AONL:

- Improve documentation timeliness by 90%
- Reduce incidental nurse overtime by 50%
- Increase Press Ganey scores on nursing-sensitive questions up to 37%

View a presentation by Cedars-Sinai nurse leaders to the American Medical Informatics Association (AMIA):

https://amia.org/education-events/education-catalog/25x5-webinar-series-reducing-burden-elevating-care-lessons

_published_faq.name: How do I add Aiva to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Aiva to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.aiva.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Aiva MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Aiva lists 35 MCP tools, including accept_confirmation, assign_area_of_responsibility_to_current_user, cancel_work_order, control_device_channel_absolute, control_device_channel_relative, control_device_launch_app, control_device_launch_education, control_device_mute, control_device_power, control_device_volume, control_shades_absolute_height, and control_shades_relative_height.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Aiva?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Aiva in health-life-sciences on the Manufact MCP catalog include Groupon, SNOMED CT Terminology, Rhizome AI - FDA & HA Regulatory Research, Amass Connector, and BioSkepsis.
Aiva requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Aiva is developed by Aiva, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
